Bug_Title: EI: May expose internal representation by returning reference to mutable object (EI_EXPOSE_REP)
Bug_Details:
Returning a reference to a mutable object value stored in one of the object's fields
exposes the internal representation of the object. 
 If instances
 are accessed by untrusted code, and unchecked changes to
 the mutable object would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Returning a new copy of the object is better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The method 'getInternalArray' returns a reference to the internal mutable array 'internalArray'. External code can modify the contents of this array, altering the internal state of the object unintentionally.
Trigger_Explanation: The test 'testShowBug' calls 'showBug', which returns the internal mutable array. Modifying 'exposedArray' affects the original 'internalArray' in 'MutableObjectExposer', demonstrating the bug by altering the internal state of the object unexpectedly.
